climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A New Jersey AVA at the state's southern tip, set within the Outer Coastal Plain AVA. Sandy or sandy loam soils drain well, and the Atlantic Ocean and Delaware Bay moderate the climate, giving a more moderate temperature range and a longer growing season.
